subject: AWS Marketplace listing — term window, finance gating & co-sell enablement
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwo od.com>
To: Rachel Mason <rachel.mason@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing — term window, finance gating & co-sell enablement

Hi Rachel,

Great talking yesterday — excited about the potential for Redwood to power the clinical summarization workflow at Novamed. We discussed listing on AWS Marketplace and doing a co-sell path to accelerate procurement. Before I draft the mutual action plan, two quick clarifying questions that will determine the PO term and activation path: 

- Finance cadence: does Novamed prefer annual invoices or quarterly invoicing against a 12/24/36 month commitment?
- Buyer approvals: which internal groups need to sign off for Marketplace activation (Procurement, Legal, IT Security)? and are there delegated approval thresholds (e.g., < $100k approving manager vs CFO)?

If you can share those details, I’ll propose a term structure that keeps co-sell enablement timelines realistic.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Mason <rachel.mason@novamed.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — term window, finance gating & co-sell enablement

Thanks Grace — quick answers: 

- Finance: We prefer annual invoices against a 12 or 24 month commitment. Quarterly invoicing adds a lot of accounting overhead.
- Approvals: Procurement + Legal are musts for Marketplace private offers, IT Security generally signs off on a separate onboarding checklist (cloud vendor risk). For deals under ~$80k we have a delegated procurement approver; anything above goes to Procurement Director + Legal review.

I'll loop in Procurement (Dan) so you can align on evidence and timelines. We are keen to enable co-sell but need the Marketplace listing to be in good shape before AWS partner reps will engage.

Cheers,
Rachel
--
Rachel Mason
Head of Clinical Data Platforms
Novamed
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Mason <rachel.mason@novamed.com>
Cc: Dan Prior <dan.prior@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — term window, finance gating & co-sell enablement

Dan — hi, thanks for jumping on.

Ben, Neha, Karthik — looping you all in to propose a scoped approach for Novamed's marketplace private offer. High level proposal below (I will attach a draft PO template):

Proposal (initial):
- Primary path: 12-month commitment, annual invoice (preferred by Novamed).
- Optional: 24-month with 8% effective discount if Novamed wants multi-year predictability.
- Activation gating: procurement + legal signoff required; IT security must complete our vendor risk onboarding checklist before co-sell enablement.
- Co-sell timing: Once a Marketplace private offer is accepted and the PO is executed, we request AWS partner nomination. AWS will only treat it as co-sell-ready after Marketplace activation + evidence (SOC2 summary + architecture diagram).

Open questions for internal alignment:
1) Do we want to offer a short-term pilot (3 months, consumption-minimum) to reduce buyer friction?
2) Do we require finance approval for discounting below list/standard pricing? (Ben)
3) What evidence package do we push first to procurement to unblock their timeline? (Neha)

I’ve attached a draft PO with term options. If this looks good I’ll follow up with a short MAP with dates and owners.

Thanks,
Grace

On attachments: Draft_AWS_PO_Terms_20260607.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Mason <rachel.mason@novamed.com>, Dan Prior <dan.prior@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — term window, finance gating & co-sell enablement

Adding finance perspective. Short answers: 
- Discount authority: Standard approval matrix applies — up to 10% SDR/AE-authorized, >10% requires RevOps signoff, >20% needs CRO approval. For multi-year offers (>12 months) Finance prefers structured invoicing and will require a revenue recognition note in the PO.
- Pilot option: We can do a 3-month paid pilot (consumption floor) but price needs to be clearly tied to conversion terms (credit back on commit).

I attached a redline of the PO with recommended invoicing language and an example billing cadence.

-Ben
From: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Mason <rachel.mason@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — term window, finance gating & co-sell enablement

Grace and team,

Thanks for the proposal. Two items that will block a Marketplace PO from procurement side: 
1) We need SOC 2 Type II evidence or an acceptable summary and a contact for a security questionnaire.
2) Invoice cadence and billing address — please confirm whether Redwood will invoice Novamed directly (AP contact below) or if AWS Marketplace does the billing.

AP contact: AP Team <ap@novamed.com>
Procurement timeline: We can turn around standard PO paperwork in ~7 business days once evidence is provided; legal review may add another 5–7 days.

Regards,
Dan Prior
Senior Procurement Manager
Novamed
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, Rachel Mason <rachel.mason@novamed.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — term window, finance gating & co-sell enablement

Dan — thanks, noted. Attaching SOC2 summary and the draft PO redline. Quick checklist and next steps to unblock: 

- Today: I uploaded a SOC2 evidence summary (Novamed_SOC2_evidence_stub.pdf) and the PO redline to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-novamed-evidence
- By Tue (6/15): Redwood to confirm invoice path — Marketplace billing vs Redwood direct. If Novamed prefers Marketplace billing we will initiate the private offer flow with AWS and provide activation timeline.
- Procurement: Provide AP contact and preferred PO template (if different).
- Legal: We will accept a short redline review; if you need further contract language we can assign our legal lead.

Co-sell note: Once Marketplace private offer is accepted and billing path is confirmed, we will coordinate with AWS partner rep to nominate Novamed for regional co-sell. That usually takes ~5 business days after activation if evidence is in place.

If everyone agrees, I’ll send a one-page MAP with owners and dates.

Best,
Grace

Attachments: Novamed_SOC2_evidence_stub.pdf; Draft_AWS_PO_Terms_20260607.docx
